newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Winterthur says share surge is too much.
newsitem.headline: Winterthur says share surge is too much.

text.p: Winterthur Insurance Company said a surge in its share price was excessive and that it had no plans for a statement or any kind of substantial changes.
"This is somewhat overboard...We are certainly beyond a reasonable price now," spokeswoman Anna-Marie Kappeler said.

"There is too much fantasy in these prices now," she told Reuters after the registered share jumped around 100 Swiss francs or seven percent in afternoon trading on the Swiss bourse. The gains were later halved to 50 francs or 3.6 percent.
